text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Year(x, y) ::: x is written in year y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y)) → NovelWriter(y)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ Year(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003 by Dani Shapiro.
Created(familySecrets, daniShapiro) ∧ Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
American(boston) ∧ City(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornInCity(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
